<div class="proof-lab" data-proof-lab="epsilon-removal"></div>
<noscript>
  <h1>ε-removal</h1>
  <p>Replace each symbol transition by epsilon-closure, one symbol, and epsilon-closure again. Correct the initial final state exactly when its epsilon-closure meets the old final set. Induction on the word length then preserves reachability and acceptance.</p>
</noscript>
